name: int01-observations-v1
description: INT_01 performance fixture (plan task C4). N looped H.264 RTSP streams served by a standalone go2rtc, continuous recording plus a local SOD detector at a fixed interval on every stream. X2 reruns the same workload with evidence enabled.
source: synthetic: ffmpeg lavfi testsrc2, 30 s clip, published into go2rtc by one always-on ffmpeg -re -stream_loop -1 -c copy per stream
transport: RTSP over TCP from standalone go2rtc on 127.0.0.1 (lightNVR's own go2rtc integration disabled, as in the contract fixture)

detector.kind: local SOD CNN (unified detection thread, annotation-only because continuous recording is on)
detector.model_note: SOD tiny YOLO VOC-20 model; not vendored (63 MB). Pass --model; its sha256 is recorded.

retention.note: Recording retention/quota is unlimited in the fixture (storage.max_size = 0) so retention sweeps do not perturb the window. Evidence byte/queue budgets do not exist in disabled mode; X2 records the C1 budgets it runs with in results.feature.
